ranking_note: Authored from the before description at commit 41c2c93072, frozen before any rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. The x plugin ships one skill, so no same-plugin competitor exists. The competitors live in other plugins: knowledge:video-digest claims x.com and twitter.com video URLs, firecrawl:firecrawl takes blocked or JavaScript-heavy pages, and discovery:research multi-source research. Plugin eval loads only this plugin, so near-miss negatives test that the skill stays quiet, not competitor wins. The description's skip clause covers private, protected and deleted posts, so one negative names a protected post.
